newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-IAMA raises A$20.3 million with issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-IAMA raises A$20.3 million with issue.

text.p: Rural services group IAMA Ltd said on Tuesday it had completed a placement of seven million shares at A$2.90 each to raise A$20.3 million.

Managing director Danny Bourke said the issue would help the company widen its base of institutional shareholders as well as retire debt and position the group to pursue its strategy of retail and distribution expansion.
IAMA shares closed at A$3.04 on Monday and were trading at A$3.02 late on Tuesday. The placement represents just under 10 percent of the company's issued capital.
